name: KS Voskresensk to KRP-16 Gas Pipeline

values.PipelineName: KS Voskresensk to KRP-16 Gas Pipeline
values.OtherEnglishNames: Voskresensk-KRP-16 gas pipeline, KGMO-KRP-16 offtake, Воскресенск — КРП-16
values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: No official GIS route. OSM seed 'Воскресенск — КРП-16' (DN1020, operator Gazprom transgaz Moskva) totals ~118 km but shares ways with the KRP-11 string (~99.5 km), so it cannot be used as-is; geometry must be separated by hand.

researcher_notes: Not matched to a GEM row: roster (GGIT 20260930) has only the KGMO ring (P2380, P2379, P2312) and the CAC-2/Kasimovskoye lines ending at Voskresensk (P2291, P2321), none a KRP feeder; OSM seed coverage by roster routes 0.08. Source: Moscow govt decree 741-PP of 24.08.2010, Appendix 2 (Garant, lapsed), Table 6.1 'technical parameters of supply pipelines from KGMO to KRP': KRP-16 offtake 87.8 km, 1020 mm; same text calls them 'seven radial trunk gas pipelines (MG) from KGMO to KRP', says KS Voskresensk supplies KRP 11, 16 and 15, and notes that KRP-11/16/17 have no reserve line (single string). url_verifier OK, names KRP-16 and states 87.8 km. Existence/operation: Gazprom transgaz Moskva news 2015-02-27 (Wayback copy; live host timed out) says KRP-16 was rebuilt to 2200 thousand m3/h, fed by a second DN1000 input off 'MG Voskresensk - KRP-11' (660 m), and lies in the operational responsibility of Gazprom transgaz Moskva; Moscow decree 408-PP (2019, Garant) still treats KRP-16 as an operating source (not cited for a value). Threshold: sponsor/operator Gazprom transgaz Moskva; endpoints KS Voskresensk to KRP-16 (Moscow Oblast); operating line never captured by GEM, so no pending step is needed; sourced length 87.8 km >= 25 km. Tier medium: single source for the length, a 2010 planning table (a lapsed decree), no second independent figure (2019 decree 408-PP repeats the 62.5 km KRP-17 feeder but gives none for KRP-16). Caveats for staging: (1) the table gives the offtake from the KGMO ring, with Voskresensk named as KRP-16's supplying CS only in the surrounding text, so StartLocation is the supply CS, not a surveyed tap point; (2) the Gazprom page's trunk name 'MG Voskresensk - KRP-11' suggests the KRP-16 string shares corridor with the KRP-11 feeder (candidate ks-voskresensk-krp-11, 98.6 km), so do not sum the two lengths as separate pipe without geometry; (3) OSM total 118 km vs 87.8 km sourced is unreconciled. Not filled (no source): Capacity (2200 thousand m3/h is the KRP station, not the pipe), start year (KRP-16 itself commissioned 1986 per the same decree's table, feeder year not stated), Parent, cost. Owner filled as operator entity; entity_lookup returns only 'Transgaz' (not the same entity), so a new owner entity 'Gazprom transgaz Moskva LLC' would be needed.
